users.title: Users
users.description: Everyone who can sign in to MetaMCP: their role, groups, sign-in methods and what they own.
users.addDescription: Create an account with an email and password. Users signing in with SSO are created automatically.
users.name: Name
users.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters. Share it securely: the user can change it after signing in.

empty.title: No users match
empty.description: Try another search or clear the filters.

users.resetPasswordDescription: {{name}} will be signed out of every device and will need this password to sign in with email.
users.passwordUpdated: Password updated. Existing sessions were signed out.
users.disableHelp: Disabling signs the user out, revokes their MCP OAuth tokens and suspends their API keys. Everything is kept and comes back if the account is enabled again.
users.deleteDescription: This cannot be undone. Consider disabling the account instead: it keeps everything and can be reverted.
users.noOwnedResources: This user owns no MCP servers, namespaces or endpoints.

deleteKeysNote.one: Their API key will be deleted.
deleteKeysNote.other: Their {{count}} API keys will be deleted.

transfer.legend: What should happen to their {{servers}} MCP server(s), {{namespaces}} namespace(s) and {{endpoints}} endpoint(s)?
transfer.organizationHelp: Recommended. Administrators manage them and existing shares keep working.
transfer.userHelp: The chosen user becomes the owner.
transfer.deleteHelp: Endpoints stop working for everyone who used them.

details.baseRoleHelp: The base role applies unless a group grants a higher one.
details.elevated: Effective role: {{role}}, granted by {{groups}}. The base role only applies if they leave those groups.
details.noGroups: Not a member of any group.
details.neverSynced: Has not signed in with SSO yet.
details.noExternalGroups: The identity provider sent no groups.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Group people to give them a role and access to MCP servers and namespaces. Groups can be filled automatically from your identity provider.
groups.formDescription: Members get the role below (if any) and everything shared with the group.
groups.name: Name
groups.grantedRoleHelp: Members get at least this role. Useful to give a whole team editor rights, or to map an IdP group to administrators.
groups.adminsRoleLocked: Members of Administrators are always administrators.
groups.noRoleHelp: Members keep their own role; the group is only used for sharing.
groups.idpGroupsHelp: At each SSO login, users whose groups claim contains one of these values join this group. Case-insensitive, * is a wildcard.

empty.title: No groups yet
empty.description: Create groups for your teams, share namespaces with them, and map them to your identity provider so membership stays in sync.

groups.notFound: This group does not exist anymore.
groups.deleteDescription: Members lose the role and the access this group gave them. Resources are not deleted.
groups.addMembersDescription: Members added here stay in the group even if the identity provider does not send it.
groups.noMembersSso: Members will appear here as they sign in with SSO, or add them manually.
groups.noMembersManual: Add people manually, or map identity provider groups to fill it automatically.
groups.oidcRemovalNote: SSO members are removed automatically when the identity provider stops sending the group. Removing them here only lasts until their next sign-in.
groups.everyoneMembersDescription: Use this group to share a namespace or a server with the whole organisation, including people who join later.
groups.everyoneNoMapping: Every user already belongs to “Everyone”, so it cannot be mapped to identity provider groups.
groups.mappingIntro: Values are compared with the “{{claim}}” claim of the ID token at each SSO login.
groups.oidcNotConfigured: No OIDC provider is configured: mappings apply once single sign-on is enabled.
groups.mappingsSaved: Mappings saved. They apply at each user's next sign-in.
groups.testerIntro: Paste the groups of a user (one per line) to check whether they would join this group.
groups.saveBeforeTest: Save your changes to test them.
groups.noShares: Nothing is shared with this group
groups.noSharesDescription: Open an MCP server or a namespace and use Share to give this group access.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.description: Choose what editors and viewers are allowed to do. Administrators can always do everything.
roles.matrixDescription: Changes apply immediately to every user holding the role.

mcp_servers.create.label: Add remote MCP servers
mcp_servers.create.description: Connect SSE and Streamable HTTP servers, and import server configurations.

mcp_servers.create_stdio.label: Add and edit STDIO servers
mcp_servers.create_stdio.description: STDIO servers run a command on the MetaMCP host: this is equivalent to shell access. Also needed to install servers from the registry.

namespaces.create.label: Create namespaces
namespaces.create.description: Combine the MCP servers they can use into their own namespaces.

endpoints.create.label: Create endpoints
endpoints.create.description: Publish namespaces they manage as MCP, SSE and OpenAPI endpoints (always authenticated).

resources.share.label: Share with others
resources.share.description: Share what they manage with other people, groups or the whole organisation.

api_keys.create.label: Create API keys
api_keys.create.description: Personal keys used by MCP clients to connect to the endpoints they can use.

inspector.use.label: Use the MCP inspector
inspector.use.description: Browse and call, from the web UI, the tools of servers and namespaces shared with them. Anyone who can edit a server or namespace can always test it.

defaultRole.title: Role of new users
defaultRole.description: Given to every account created from now on (email sign-up, SSO or admin).
defaultRole.help: Groups mapped from your identity provider can grant a higher role at sign-in.

adminOnly.title: Always reserved to administrators
adminOnly.users: Managing users, groups, roles and single sign-on
adminOnly.logs: Live logs and the audit logs of every user
adminOnly.organisation: Organisation-owned resources and organisation API keys

sso.title: Single sign-on
sso.description: Keep groups and roles in sync with your identity provider (OIDC).
sso.notConfiguredHelp: Set OIDC_CLIENT_ID, OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET and OIDC_DISCOVERY_URL to enable single sign-on. You can prepare group mappings in the meantime.

flow.title: How roles are assigned
flow.step1Help: Read from the “{{claim}}” claim of the ID token at each login.
flow.step2Help: Each MetaMCP group lists the IdP values it accepts.
flow.step3Help: Users get the highest role of their groups and everything shared with them.

sso.groupsClaimHelp: Usually “groups”. Use a dot path for nested claims, e.g. realm_access.roles (Keycloak roles). Make sure the claim is added to the ID token.
sso.syncGroups: Sync group memberships at each login
sso.syncGroupsHelp: Adds and removes SSO memberships to match the identity provider. Members added manually are never removed.
sso.requireMatch: Only allow users from mapped groups
sso.requireMatchHelp: Refuse SSO logins whose groups match no MetaMCP group. Accounts with a password are not affected.

tester.title: Test a mapping
tester.description: Paste the groups a user receives (one per line) to preview the groups and role they would get.
tester.resultingRole: Resulting role for a new user:
tester.denied: This login would be refused (no mapped group).
tester.noMatch: No MetaMCP group matches these values.

mappings.title: Mappings
mappings.description: IdP group values and the MetaMCP groups they fill.
mappings.empty: No group is mapped to your identity provider yet. Open a group and add IdP groups in its Identity provider tab.

security.title: Encryption at rest
security.description: Credentials stored by MetaMCP are encrypted with data keys, themselves protected by a key that never touches the database.

dedicated.title: Local key (SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY)
dedicated.description: Data keys are wrapped by a dedicated key from the environment. Keep it in your secret store: without it, stored credentials cannot be read.

derived.title: Key derived from BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
derived.description: Secrets are encrypted, but with a key derived from BETTER_AUTH_SECRET. Set a dedicated SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY (or use OpenBao) so both secrets can be rotated independently.
derived.exampleSecret: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET still has its public example value: anyone can decrypt your secrets. Set BETTER_AUTH_SECRET and SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY to random values, then restart.

openbao.title: OpenBao / Vault Transit
openbao.description: Data keys are wrapped by a Transit key that never leaves OpenBao. MetaMCP only calls it at startup and during rotations: an OpenBao outage does not affect running instances.

security.encryptedList: MCP server URLs, arguments, environment values, headers and bearer tokens; upstream OAuth tokens and client secrets; identity provider tokens.
security.hashedList: API keys, and MetaMCP OAuth access tokens, refresh tokens, codes and client secrets: they are shown once and can never be read back.

plaintextPending.one: {{count}} value is still stored in clear text; it will be encrypted at the next restart.
plaintextPending.other: {{count}} values are still stored in clear text; they will be encrypted at the next restart.

security.rotateDescription: A new data key is created. It becomes active in about {{minutes}} min, once every MetaMCP instance has loaded it, then all stored secrets are re-encrypted with it. Nothing stops working in the meantime.
security.rotatedDescription: Key {{key}} becomes active at {{time}}; secrets will then be re-encrypted.
security.rotateError: The data key could not be rotated

activity.title: Activity log
activity.description: Who changed access, configuration and resources, and every sign-in. Entries cannot be modified.
activity.descriptionRetention: Who changed access, configuration and resources, and every sign-in. Entries cannot be modified and are kept {{days}} days.
activity.exportTruncated: Only the 10,000 most recent matching entries were exported.
activity.exportError: The activity log could not be exported

group.memberships_synced: Groups synchronised from the identity provider

activity.sheetDescription: Recorded by MetaMCP. Secret values are never stored in the activity log.

empty.title: No activity
empty.description: Nothing matches these filters yet. Changes to users, groups, roles, sharing, resources and settings appear here, along with sign-ins.
